name: IC Microcontroller — 5V, USB, 2.3V — SSOP
description: Cluster of SMD 5V and 2.3V USB microcontrollers in SSOP packages, featuring Tier A KiCad symbols for Microchip PIC18 components.
selection_hints: Selecting Microchip PIC18 microcontrollers with USB and 5V/2.3V facets.
Using SMD layout with the SSOP-28_5.3x10.2mm_P0.65mm footprint.
Requiring Tier A KiCad microcontroller symbol entries.
avoid_when: The layout requires a footprint other than SSOP-28_5.3x10.2mm_P0.65mm.
Through-hole mounting is required instead of SMD.
The design requires a microcontroller outside the 5V, 2.3V, or USB feature set.
